skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Aftershow
skins.content: Greyy festival costume/Aftershow. Finely-crafted costumes and props made by the Operators are very popular amongst the Rhodes Island audience.
skins.usage: One of Greyy the Lightningbearer's casual outfits.
skins.quote: At the 1st-anniversary performance commemorating the premiere of the Rhodes Island-version of The Nutcracker, Greyy takes the stage again amidst the cheers of the crowd, closing the curtains on today's show along with the 'musicians' on stage.

skins.name: Biochemical Submergence
skins.content: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/Biochemical Submergence. Outfit of the detective who snuck into the Hospital of Horror. Falling into a mysterious liquid, his back laden with a biochemical tank that may serve as key evidence. Can he uncover the terrifying truth?
skins.usage: One of Greyy the Lightningbearer's role-playing outfits.
skins.quote: The mad doctor orders the nurse to start the lab's high-power shock machine! The detective rises once more from the operating table that prophesied his death! Will he be able to escape this deadly experiment? To Be Continued, in the next issue!
